findings.title: Nested MasterDetail leaves bypass the existing composition depth limit
findings.evidence: composition::master_detail wraps a block with nested Group children as ChildContent::Leaf; Child::nested_depth returns0 for every leaf. validate_composition only checks each immediate child Group depth, whose cached depth has already forgotten any nested MasterDetail. Independent public facade test builds MAX_COMPOSITION_DEPTH+2 (130) nested Group/MasterDetail blocks; every adapter constructor accepts them, contrary to the128 bounded composition contract. The deterministic assertion fails without executing an intentionally crashing render. Subsequent recursive measurement/drawing can therefore run beyond the guarded limit.
findings.actual: No constructor rejects130 nested public blocks.
findings.expected: Combined composition depth remains accounted through block boundaries; an over-limit structure is rejected before recursive measure/draw.
findings.required_fix: Carry the maximum nested master/detail/summary group depth through the existing Child/Group depth accounting (a dedicated structural child variant or equivalent metadata), validate the combined tree, and preserve fallible rejection. Do not raise the limit, flatten to a guessed depth or silently render empty output. Add a failing-before regression through the public adapter.

source_review.borrowing: Exact configured MasterDetail and caller-owned immutable MasterDetailState are borrowed; existing child groups carry borrowed node/row closures and item slices. No whole application import, cloned persistent state, update call or new renderer introduced.
source_review.measurement: Delegates existing MasterDetail::measure, which resolves shared layout and uses cloned measurement split state; no component update/domain action. Constructor rejects missing required slots and immediate group depth errors. New finding concerns cumulative nested depth only.
source_review.rendering: with_area(logical) delegates existing MasterDetail::show; runtime resolver retains allocated child area and clips leaf output. Existing block owns focus scopes, split/drawer state, hit regions and cursor. Existing Group trait bridge is real and compiled.
source_review.errors: Size-returning Measure and void CompositionLeaf intentionally cannot propagate errors. Adapter catches errors after creation using zero-size/ignored draw, matching existing Group trait conventions; correctness depends on complete structural validation, currently undermined by the depth finding.
source_review.compatibility: Additive function and private helper only; existing state and action enums unchanged. No unsafe/concurrency changes.
